content: In the draft decoder, we first introduce BERT's word embedding matrix to map the previous summary draft outputs $\lbrace y_1, \ldots , y_{t-1}\rbrace $ into embeddings vectors $\lbrace q_1, \ldots , q_{t-1}\rbrace $ at t-th time step. Note that as the input sequence of the decoder is not complete, we do not use the BERT network to predict the context vectors here.
